title: 上海高考翻译背诵-72-25一模

items.zh: 记得修水管,否则厨房很快就会水漫金山。
items.en: Remember to fix the water pipes, or the kitchen will soon be flooded.

items.zh: 我们不妨送她一个带通控功能的空气净化器作为乔迁礼物。
items.en: We might as well get her a remote-controlled air purifier as a housewarming gift.

items.zh: 如果准新娘们认为婚纱是重中之重,那只能削减其他项的开支以防婚礼预算超支。
items.en: If brides-to-be think the wedding dress is top priority, they can only cut other expenses to avoid going over budget.

items.zh: 与其他国家消费者相比,很多中国人并不习惯信用卡支付,移动支付能在中国迅速崛起,一定程度上也得益于此。
items.en: Compared with other countries’ consumers, many Chinese are not used to payment by credit card, partly leading to the rapid rise in mobile payment.
